findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order · Private data: get_growth_plan, get_my_mt5_account, place_mt5_order, modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order · Public sink: modify_mt5_order · Destructive: modify_mt5_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order · Private data: get_growth_plan, get_my_mt5_account, place_mt5_order, modify_mt5_order, close_mt5_order · Public sink: modify_mt5_order · Destructive: modify_mt5_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
